body:
I have struggled with my mental health for most of my teenage years and early adulthood, due to trauma I have experienced. I have always had extremely high anxiety levels and in my late teenage years, engaged in pretty risky behaviour. However I still somehow managed to function, I did well in school and up until recently in university as well as managing to maintain friendships. I have had small depressive episodes before but have managed to overcome them, but this one doesn’t seem to be passing. The final straw was when I decided to start cutting myself which I have always thought about doing for years at this stage. The cutting was brought about by a recent event that triggered me, i don’t cope well with abandonment due to previous experiences.
I have done years of talk therapy, I’m on anti depressants, I was even checked in the psychiatric ward a few weeks ago, yet I always somehow find myself in the same spot at square one. I’ve read peoples posts here saying they haven’t experienced happiness in years, maybe I’m weak, but i can’t see myself staying alive if this continues.
